subject: prd/self-drive-wake
statement: If a review attempt is killed, fails, produces unauthentic evidence, or remains pending when the next drive round has no ready implementation task, then the system shall exact-read and retain the same obligation, schedule only consumer-bounded review-only recovery, preserve its last closed failure class, and remain non-clean through recovery exhaustion; never redispatch implementation or derive the reviewed revision from the current proposal head
intent: implementation stays succeeded; review stays visibly pending/red with provider-attempt and consumer recovery counters/remedy, or exhausted/escalated
fit_criterion: kill/restart, absent/malformed/forged artifact, factory/auth/infrastructure, moving-head, empty-frontier, and exhausted-bound fixtures retain one exact obligation, count every admitted review-only sweep, launch zero implementation, and never report clean until authenticated verification
